✨ Sherry Episode 2 | Inside the Revision ✨

This is revision surgery.

And revision surgery tells a story.

Every scar…

Every suture…

Every distorted tissue plane…

Every decision made years before.

Sherry came to The Maercks Institute after a previous facelift left behind many of the classic findings we discuss so often:

⚠️ High lateral skin tension
⚠️ Pixie-ear deformity
⚠️ Wide, visible scars
⚠️ Midface descent
⚠️ Heavy neck
⚠️ Poor structural support

What looked like “tightness” from the outside was actually a lack of deep support underneath.

As we began surgery, we encountered exactly what revision surgery often reveals:

Scar tissue.

Permanent foreign material.

Distorted anatomy.

Tissues that had healed under tension rather than support.

Revision surgery isn’t simply repeating a facelift.

It’s carefully undoing years of altered anatomy before rebuilding it correctly.

The MAERCKS Trifecta Revision focuses on three structural corrections:

✨ Deep ligamentous support of the midface
✨ Lateral platysma suspension to restore the neck
✨ Submental reconstruction to redefine the jawline and floor of the mouth

As soon as the deep support is restored…

Everything changes.

The neck elevates.

The jawline appears.

The excess skin becomes loose—not because the skin was pulled—but because the foundation underneath has been restored.

One of my favorite moments during every revision is watching the facial volume reverse itself.

Before:

⬇️ Heavy below the base of the nose
⬆️ Hollow above

After:

⬆️ Beautiful cheek support
⬇️ Clean jawline and neck

The square face becomes a heart-shaped face.

The skeleton disappears beneath healthy soft tissue.

The mandibular angle becomes visible again.

Revision surgery is one of the greatest challenges in facial plastic surgery.

Not because it’s more difficult technically.

Because every patient deserves a second chance.

And that responsibility is something we never take lightly.

Mission accomplished. ✨

#RevisionFacelift #MaercksLift #DeepPlaneFacelift #FacialHarmony #TheMaercksInstitute SubtleButProfound

✨ 12 Days Later | The Glow Is Structural ✨

“People keep asking if I had filler...”

Nope.

We didn’t add volume.

We simply put it back where it belongs. 🤍

Just 12 days after a MAERCKS Trifecta, the transformation is already speaking for itself.

✨ Brighter eyes✨ Defined jawline✨ Restored cheek support✨ A naturally fuller lip✨ A healthy, rested appearance

One of my favorite things to explain is this:

People often think youth comes from adding volume.

It doesn’t.

It comes from positioning volume correctly.

Before:

⬇️ Soft tissue had descended.⬆️ The skeleton was exposed.⬇️ The lower face felt heavy.

After:

⬆️ Soft tissue is supported back over the cheekbones.⬇️ The jawline is clean.✨ The lips appear fuller—not because we touched them, but because they’re no longer hidden by descended tissues.

That’s structural facial rejuvenation.

Her favorite changes?

✨ “The area around my eyes.”✨ “My jawline.”✨ “I just look different.”

My favorite?

She doesn’t look like she had surgery.

She looks like...

“I actually slept really well.”

Exactly.

Healthy.

Rested.

Refreshed.

The most surprising part for her wasn’t the surgery.

It was the recovery.

“I couldn’t believe how quickly the swelling went down.”

At just 12 days, she’s already back to life, back to confidence, and every week from here will continue to refine the result.

Because great facial rejuvenation doesn’t announce itself.

It simply lets people wonder:

“You look amazing... what’s different?”

✨ That’s the goal.

#MaercksLift #DeepPlaneFacelift #Trifecta #FacialHarmony #TheMaercksInstitute SubtleButProfound
